newsitem.title: CANADA: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.5 percent.
newsitem.headline: Bank of Canada sets specials at 3.5 percent.

text.p: The Bank of Canada on Thursday conducted a round of special purchase and resale agreements in the money markets at 3.5 percent.
The central bank conducted the operation after the call loan or overnight lending rate drifted to the top of the central bank's 3.0-3.5 percent target range.
Dealers said the rise in the call loan rate was linked primarily to settlement pressures from Tuesday's weekly T-bill auction and another round of specials is possible.

"Demand is still pretty strong. You've got a lot of things going on. You've got a month end, a quarter end which corresponds to the chartered banks' quarter end, so there's a lot of noise in the system today," said one T-bill dealer with a bank-owned brakerage.
"I would think that there's probably enough cash in the system, but people are being very stingy with it."
